input.old_string: On synthetic data at base scale, classification DAPT recovers OOD detection (F1\,=\,0.97--1.0 vs.\ vanilla 0.26--0.31), though robustness does not extend to strategy-diverse scenarios under mixed-LLM training (ActorAttack F1\,=\,0.504); on human data, the hierarchy reverses (ToxicChat MLM 0.837 vs.\ classification 0.596)---the advantage is condition-specific and counterproductive at 355M scale. Few-shot benign adaptation reduces FPR from 58--68\% to 0--1.5\% with 10--25 conversations (Appendix~\ref{app:calibration}). This ablation framework provides a reusable template for diagnosing when domain adaptation succeeds and fails in this safety-critical detection setting.
